illness.unwell: A member of our community is unwell. Please remember them in your duas.
illness.hospital: A member of our community is in hospital. Please make dua for their recovery.
illness.surgery: A member of our community is having an operation. Please make dua that it goes well.

inteqal.passed: A member of our community has passed away. Please make dua for them and for their family.
inteqal.family: Please keep the family of the deceased in your duas and give them your support.
inteqal.janaza: A member of our community has passed away. Please join the janaza if you can.

other.difficulty: A member of our community is going through a difficult time. Please remember them in your duas.
other.exams: Our students have their exams. Please make dua for their success.
other.travel: Members of our community are travelling for Hajj or Umrah. Please remember them in your duas.
